title: Lecture 1 — computation, variables, and text
summary: Programs execute instructions in sequence, choose branches through selection, and repeat work through iteration. Python variables bind names to values, while strings store text as indexed character sequences.
body: Sequence, selection, and iteration determine which instruction runs next. Python evaluates expressions and binds their values to names; the value carries its type. Strings are ordered character sequences, so indexing, slicing, membership tests, and loops all operate on their positions and elements.
